newsitem.title: BRAZIL: No CVRD auction until next week -reports.
newsitem.headline: No CVRD auction until next week -reports.

text.p: The privatization of Brazilian state miner Cia Vale do Rio Doce, which had been reset for this morning, will not occur until at least Monday, local news reports said.
TV Globo said Planning Minister Antonio Kandir had ordered the National Development Bank (BNDES) to put off the auction set for today on the Rio de Janeiro Stock Exchange.

The reported move came after the head of Brazil's Superior Court of Justice, Democrito Reinaldo, said he will not rule before Monday on a government request that all injunctions impeding the sale be heard by a single court.
"I will examine the process on Saturday and Sunday and on Monday I may have a decision," he told reporters Thursday.

The move, if granted, would allow the government to move to quickly overturn injunctions that had been approved by several different courts and move ahead with its planned sale of a 45-percent controlling stake in CVRD.
The auction had been originally scheduled for 1000 local/1300 GMT/1300 GMT Tuesday but the selloff, the largest in Latin American history, has been delayed by a slew of court challenges.
